description: Unchanged original page-world window.close guard test against the pinned source module.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Minimal node environment; the original test stubs its own window global and needs none of the source renderer setup, aliases, feature-wall define, GC/webstorage flags or extended timeouts.
dependencyClosureNote: The unchanged test imports Vitest and one import-free sibling module.
isolationRationale: The test owns a stub window object and Vitest restores the global after the single synchronous case. It launches no Electron process and reaches no filesystem, network, child process, credentials or service.
